node.title: L1 Pade split-section/support-moment inversion
node.statement: For any evaluation set and m>=k, the number C_m(U) of m-subsets on which U has a degree-below-k interpolant equals the split-point count of the unguarded full-locator Pade section and equals sum_{a>=m} binom(a,m)Z_a(U), where Z_a counts codewords with complete agreement size a. The exact-shell gcd guard selects Z_m, and finite binomial inversion gives Z_a=sum_{m>=a}(-1)^(m-a)binom(m,a)C_m. Thus upstream's shifted-lattice/split-pencil support census is exactly the unguarded Pade split count and directly upper-bounds the exact shell. Primitive-owner and finite base-field budget conventions are not identified by this transform.
